== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Leia Seeker (Japanese)|Leia Seeker]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=67740 Japanese A New Hope source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(0, 21, 462, 640)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>4a5a13f6e5eb5b8ea856e793092be13bef016ac4d5f99576f20a38a4bc910fdd</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/02/Japanese-ANH-Leia-Seeker-SWCA-67740.jpg Internet Archive item].
